comments.body:
Heya, a lot of the information on the entrance exams is available here: https://ethz.ch/en/studies/bachelor/application/non-swiss-matriculation-certificate/eth-entrance-examination.html

Specifically, you will need to check if you will need to take the reduced or comprehensive exam. A rough idea of what subjects the maths exam will cover is here: https://ethz.ch/content/dam/ethz/main/education/admission/bachelor/andere-qual/pruefungsinhalte/rAP.pdf
They also suggest textbooks somewhere below, but to be honest there’s not a lot of information online, I think somebody uploaded all the past papers online though.

Unfortunately the document is in German. But the exam will be in German, as I am sure you are aware the majority (or at the very least in the first year) of an ETH Bachelor’s is in German. I hope this helps!
comments.author: jetblack164
